qiblaPathInfoTitle: How is the Qibla path calculated?
qiblaPathExplanation: This line shows the shortest path from your selected location to the Kaaba, calculated using the WGS84 model of the Earth. On a flat map, the path may appear curved, especially over long distances. Over shorter distances, it may look almost straight. The Qibla arrow shows the direction to follow at your location.

helpPage.title: How to use QiblaMap
helpPage.intro: Choose a tool and follow its step-by-step instructions.

camera.title: Find the Qibla with the camera
camera.start: Open the Camera page and tap "Start camera". Allow access to your camera.
camera.gps: Tap "Detect my location" and allow location access so the Qibla direction can be calculated.
camera.hold: Hold your phone upright and slowly turn in the indicated direction.
camera.confirm: When the camera is accurately aligned with the Qibla, the Kaaba is confirmed in the center. The camera image freezes temporarily and your device may vibrate.

compass.title: Find the Qibla with the compass
compass.gps: Open the Compass page and tap "Detect my location" to use your current position.
compass.hold: Keep your phone as level as possible and avoid tilting it too much.
compass.direction: Turn slowly and watch the compass needle until it points toward the Kaaba.
compass.accuracy: Keep your phone away from magnets and electronic interference. Accuracy depends on your device's sensors.

map.title: Find the Qibla with the map
map.gps: First, tap "Detect my location". Your current position will be detected and the Qibla arrow will appear on the map.
map.direction: The arrow shows you the Qibla direction from your current location.
map.path: For more details, enable "Show Qibla path". This lets you follow the direction toward the Kaaba on the map. You can also use the full-path option to display the entire path.
map.manual: If you prefer not to use GPS, you can select your location manually on the map or search for a city or address.

privacyPage.intro: QiblaMap displays the prayer direction based on a selected location. This page explains which data is used for this purpose.
privacyPage.locationText: When you request location detection, QiblaMap asks your browser for your latitude, longitude, and estimated accuracy. These details are used to display the map and calculate the Qibla direction. The reviewed application code does not explicitly send GPS coordinates to the Geoapify search API.
privacyPage.storageText: A detected GPS location, including its accuracy, is saved in sessionStorage for the browser session. A manually selected location is saved in localStorage and remains there until it is replaced or removed. Your selected language and appearance settings are also saved in localStorage.
privacyPage.searchText: When you search for a place, your search text is sent to the QiblaMap API. A Cloudflare Worker processes the request and forwards the search text to Geoapify. To limit search requests, the Worker uses the IP address provided by Cloudflare. The services involved may process additional technical request data.
privacyPage.tilesText: When you view the map, your browser downloads map tiles directly from tile.openstreetmap.org. The provider may receive your IP address, technical request information, and information about the requested map areas. Light and dark map modes use the same tile provider.
privacyPage.hostingText: Cloudflare is intended to host the public QiblaMap website. When visiting the website, technical connection data, particularly IP addresses and requested URLs, will be transmitted to Cloudflare. Cloudflare may process this information to deliver and secure the service and investigate errors. Specific logging periods and possible international data transfers must be reviewed before publication based on the services used.
privacyPage.operatorText: Responsible for QiblaMap and contact for privacy questions:
privacyPage.paypalText: QiblaMap displays a PayPal link and a locally stored QR code for voluntary support. Simply displaying the QR code does not connect to PayPal. If you open the PayPal link or visit PayPal through the QR code, PayPal may process personal and payment information.
privacyPage.retentionText: Your detected location is stored in sessionStorage and normally remains available only for the browser session. Manually selected locations, language, and appearance settings remain in localStorage until replaced or deleted. You can remove this information through your browser's website data settings and change location permissions in your browser settings. This does not delete any information that external providers may hold.
privacyPage.rightsText: Under the GDPR, and subject to the applicable conditions, you may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, object to processing, and where applicable data portability. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. For questions or requests, please use the email address provided above.
privacyPage.reviewNotice: Notice: This privacy policy is still being prepared. Legal bases, data subject rights, hosting, retention and logging periods, and possible international data transfers must be reviewed and documented before publication.

imprintPage.donationText: The money received will be passed on to people in need. None of it will be used for the developer's personal benefit.
imprintPage.qrAlt: PayPal QR code for voluntary support
imprintPage.paypalNotice: Opening the PayPal link or scanning the QR code will take you to PayPal.

qiblaFaqPage.intro: Find simple answers to common questions about the Qibla and the Kaaba.
qiblaFaqPage.meaningAnswer: The Qibla is the direction Muslims face during prayer. It points towards the Kaaba in Mecca.
qiblaFaqPage.unityQuestion: Why do Muslims face the same direction when praying?
qiblaFaqPage.unityAnswer: A shared prayer direction connects Muslims around the world. The Quran instructs Muslims to face the Sacred Mosque in Mecca (2:144).
qiblaFaqPage.worshipAnswer: No. Muslims worship God (Allah), not the Kaaba. The Kaaba serves as a common point of direction during prayer.
qiblaFaqPage.builderQuestion: Who built the Kaaba and when?
qiblaFaqPage.builderAnswer: According to the Quran, Abraham (Ibrahim) and his son Ishmael (Ismail) raised the foundations of the Kaaba (2:127). Its exact historical construction date is not known with certainty.
qiblaFaqPage.locationAnswer: The Kaaba is located inside the Sacred Mosque, al-Masjid al-Haram, in Mecca, Saudi Arabia.
qiblaFaqPage.calculationQuestion: How does QiblaMap calculate the prayer direction?
qiblaFaqPage.calculationAnswer: QiblaMap calculates the direction from the selected location to the Kaaba using the WGS84 Earth model. The arrow shows the prayer direction at that location.

compassPage.aligned: According to the compass, you are facing the Qibla.
compassPage.selectLocation: First select a location on the map.
compassPage.infoTitle: How does the Qibla compass work?
compassPage.infoExplanation: The fixed golden needle points toward the top of your smartphone. The Kaaba symbol marks the prayer direction. Rotate your smartphone until the Kaaba symbol is directly above the golden needle.
compassPage.infoTip: For the most reliable results with the current sensor calculation, hold your smartphone flat with the screen facing up toward the sky and the back facing the ground. Keep it away from magnets and metal objects. Sensor readings may fluctuate more when the phone is upright. The displayed location accuracy refers only to the GPS position, not to compass accuracy.
